verses.text: These are the people who put their seals on the agreement: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
The Levites were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the family of Henadad, Kadmiel,
and their fellow Levites: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
The leaders of the people were: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

The rest of the people also joined in: the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants, and everyone who had separated themselves from the peoples around them to obey God's law, together with their wives, sons, and daughters, everyone old enough to understand.

They joined their relatives and leaders and made a promise, under a curse if they broke it, to follow God's law, which was given through God's servant Moses. They promised to carefully obey all the commands, rules, and laws of the LORD our Lord.
We promise not to let our daughters marry the peoples around us, and not to let our sons marry their daughters.

If the peoples around us bring goods or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any other holy day. Every seventh year we will not farm the land, and we will cancel all debts.
We also accept the duty to give about four grams of silver each year for the service of the temple of our God.

This is for the holy bread, the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings, the offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon festivals, and at the set festivals, for the holy offerings, for the sin offerings to make Israel right with God, and for all the work of the temple of our God.
We, the priests, Levites, and people, have thrown lots to decide when each family will bring wood to the temple of our God each year, to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as written in the law.
We promise to bring to the LORD's temple every year the first part of our harvest and the first fruit of every tree.
As the law says, we will bring our firstborn sons and the firstborn of our cattle, herds, and flocks to the temple of our God, to the priests who serve there.

We will bring to the priests, to the storerooms of the temple of our God, the first of our dough, our offerings, the fruit of all our trees, and our new wine and olive oil. We will bring a tenth of our crops to the Levites, because the Levites collect the tenth in all the towns where we farm.
A priest descended from Aaron must be with the Levites when they collect the tenth. The Levites must bring a tenth of what they collect to the temple of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.

The people of Israel and the Levites must bring their gifts of grain, new wine, and olive oil to the storerooms where the temple things are kept, and where the priests on duty, the gatekeepers, and the singers stay. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
